blocks.content: The Gramin Gyan Setu mobile application was launched on 12 August 2026 to digitally connect libraries in Gujarat’s Gandhinagar Lok Sabha constituency. The launch coincided with National Library Day, which marks the birth anniversary of Padma Shri S. R. Ranganathan, a pioneer of library science in India.

items: National Library Day is observed in India on 12 August, the birth anniversary of S. R. Ranganathan.
S. R. Ranganathan is known for the Five Laws of Library Science.
MPLAD stands for Member of Parliament Local Area Development Scheme.
Gandhinagar is the parliamentary constituency represented by Amit Shah.
